items.source: In the case of a container, this will return true only if all components that apply are currently running.
items.translation: 对于容器而言，仅当所有适用的组件当前都在运行时，此方法才返回 `true`。

items.source: Note that this stop notification is not guaranteed to come before destruction: On regular shutdown, Lifecycle beans will first receive a stop notification before the general destruction callbacks are being propagated; however, on hot refresh during a context's lifetime or on aborted refresh attempts, a given bean's destroy method will be called without any consideration of stop signals upfront.
items.translation: 请注意，此停止通知并不保证在销毁之前发出： 在常规关闭过程中，Lifecycle 圈会先接收停止通知，然后再传播通用的销毁回调；然而，在上下文生命周期期间的热刷新或中止的刷新尝试中，给定 bean 的销毁方法将在不考虑任何预先停止信号的情况下被调用。

items.source: Should not throw an exception if the component is already running.
items.translation: 如果组件已经在运行，则不应抛出异常。

items.source:
In the case of a container, this will propagate a hard start signal to all
components that apply, even to non-auto-startup components.
items.translation: 对于容器而言，这将向所有适用的组件传播硬启动信号，即使包括非自动启动的组件。

items.source: Should not throw an exception if the component is not running (not started yet).
items.translation: 如果组件尚未运行（尚未启动），则不应抛出异常。

items.source:
In the case of a container, this will propagate the stop signal to all components
that apply.
items.translation: 对于容器，这将向所有适用的组件传播停止信号。

items.source: WebSocketService implementation that handles a WebSocket HTTP handshake request by delegating to a RequestUpgradeStrategy which is either auto-detected (no-arg constructor) from the classpath but can also be explicitly configured.
items.translation: `WebSocketService` 实现处理 WebSocket HTTP 握手请求，通过委托给一个 `RequestUpgradeStrategy`（该策略可从类路径中自动检测（无参构造函数），也可以显式配置）。
